recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to white (#FFFFFF). 2. Draw a thin dark-red (#8B0000) horizontal line across the top edge (full width, ~7% from top) and a matching vertical line down the left edge (~5% from left, full height). 3. Draw a solid black rectangle as a footer bar: ~4% to ~96% width, ~96% to ~100% height. 4. Create the title box: rectangle at ~10% left, ~11% top, ~28% wide, ~10% tall; fill pale cyan (#E0FFFF), border dark blue (#000080) ~2pt; type 'Feature Extraction' in bold black Arial ~28pt, left-aligned with small padding. 5. Create the main content box: rectangle at ~10% left, ~23% top, ~82% wide, ~69% tall; fill white, thin dark-blue (#000080) border ~1pt. 6. Inside, first line at top: 'Features Types are ' in bold dark red (#C00000), then 'is ' in regular black, then 'Problem dependent' in bold italic black with underline. 7. Below it, blank line, then bold black 'Features may include:' (~20-22pt). 8. Add a bulleted list (round bullets, black, ~20pt, generous line spacing) with exactly these items in order: 'Center of Gravity location,' / 'Aspect Ratio,' / 'Length and Width,' / 'Number of intersections,' / 'Moments,' / 'Geometrical Features ,' (keep the space before the comma) / 'Colors,' / 'Transformations' / '…………' (a line of dots). 9. Do not add any charts, images, or slide numbers; optionally omit the recorded mouse cursor as it is a video artifact, not slide content.
